findings.issue: permanentClientError treats 401 and 403 as permanent. cart-service's /internal/** chain fails closed with 401 when the token is blank or wrong. A token rotation mismatch, a rolling deploy where cart-service lacks the token for a while, or a misconfigured ORDER internal token therefore makes every CLEAR_CART row that the relay touches go DEAD on its first relay attempt. Before this change those rows retried for about 26 h and recovered by themselves once the config was fixed. Now an operator has to retry them by hand (the runbook does document that DEAD retries are safe). These errors come from configuration, not the 'validation drift' that the javadoc and runbook give as the reason for going DEAD at once.
findings.fix: Also exclude 401 and 403 (for example: s >= 400 && s < 500 && s != 401 && s != 403 && s != 404 && s != 408 && s != 429), or limit immediate DEAD to 400 and 422. Add 401 to the PENDING cases in permanentClientErrorGoesDeadImmediately and update the runbook line.

findings.issue: When enqueueClearCart fails, clearCart returns without trying the inline HTTP clear. The order then loses even the best-effort clear the old code gave it, and the cart keeps the ordered lines until a 409 retry. The failure is also logged at WARN, yet it means a durable record was lost, which deserves operator attention.
findings.fix: Still call attemptClearCart after logging; its outbox.complete is already guarded by its own catch. Log the enqueue failure at ERROR.

findings.issue: The test builds the Feign builder by hand. The Spring wiring is checked only through the @FeignClient configuration array, not by FeignClientFactoryBean actually applying the per-client Capability bean. This is fine as it stands: Spring Cloud OpenFeign adds Capability beans with getInheritedAwareInstances, and Feign's enrich wraps every RequestInterceptor in the list, so the global forwarding interceptor is wrapped too.
findings.fix: Optional: add a context-level test that gets the CartInternalFeignClient bean from the FeignClientFactory/NamedContextFactory child context and checks that it has StripUserToken, or assert on headers through a WireMock-style stub.

summary: I approve b7f5b97: no blocker or major finding, one minor and two nits. All seven items from review C and security C at 71bba97 are resolved. (1) OrderRemote.clearCart now catches and logs an enqueue failure. Only two call sites use it, both outside any transaction: the 409 path at OrderService.java:284, which now still throws RESOURCE_CONFLICT, and the CARD/COD tail at line 426. In the tail, COD's events.publish(placedType) now runs before the clear. WALLET still calls enqueueClearCart directly inside the tx.execute markPaid/ORDER_PLACED transaction, uncaught, so a failure there still rolls back. No other path's real error is hidden by the catch. (2) NoUserTokenFeignConfig has no annotations, so component scan does not pick it up. CartInternalFeignClient is its only reference; Inventory, Payment, Promotion, Seller and UserInternal clients still use only InternalFeignConfig. The Capability wraps every interceptor and removes Authorization after each one, so the result does not depend on interceptor order. The test proves that the bearer leaks without the stripper and is gone with it, and that X-Internal-Token is kept. (3) lockCartIfExists does a SELECT ... FOR UPDATE without insert, and removeConsumed returns 0 when there is no cart; a new test proves no cart row is created. (4) A CLEAR_CART row now goes DEAD at once on a 4xx other than 404, 408 or 429. A circuit-breaker refusal becomes a RetryableException with status -1, so it still retries. 5xx responses also retry. All of this is tested. The minor finding is that 401 and 403 are configuration errors and should retry too. (5) The AC-18 test now fails the inline clear, changes the cart, and delivers through the relay. It would catch an implementation that re-reads the cart. AC-15 now asserts the row is due at once (<= 0). (6) The runbook Data retention section and TD-BE-19 (README row and backend.md entry) are added. The fail-first demos in evidence.md match the tests. verify-C.md records forge-verify PASS at b7f5b97. MockitoSpyBean on Outbox resets after each test by default, so the stub does not leak into other tests.
